spans.s: akṛtaka, adj. (see kṛtaka; cf. Pali akata as ep. of nibbāna, and akṛtajña 1), not created, unfashioned, in tangible, immaterial, in Laṅk standardly as epithet of ākāśa, nirvāṇa, nirodha, Often mistranslated as if active by Suzuki, no doer, not working, or the like: Laṅk 〔60.6〕; 〔72.5〕; 〔77.1〕, etc. Also more generally: sarvaṃ … kṛtakam, or sarvam … akṛtakam Laṅk 〔176.11〕 and 13, all is created or all is uncreated, as doctrines of two materialistic schools; the question is raised Laṅk 〔187.9〕 whether the Tathāgata is uncreated (akṛtakaḥ) or created (kṛtakaḥ).
akṛpaṇam, adv., not poorly, very well: SP 〔79.12〕 (Skt. kṛpaṇam and Pali kapaṇaṃ are used as adverbs, miserably).
ākṛṣṭimant, adj., quick at learning: Mvy 〔2908〕. So Tib. (lobs skyen pa, or ldob rkyen pa), confirmed by surrounding words.
